 KLAS Las Vegas Follow Showers, storms expected Friday in Las Vegas
 Tedd Florendo Fri, October 30, 2026 at 3:05 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- The countdown to Halloween weather-wise is shaping up to be a cooler and possibly soggy adventure for trick-or-treaters.
 FRIDAY: There are chances for showers and embedded thunderstorms, maybe as early as midday and through the afternoon. Expect temps to cool back to the mid-70s due to clouds and showers around. 
 HALLOWEEN: Clouds and sunbreaks through the day, but showers are supposed to pick up Halloween PM and last through Sunday AM. Last time we had rain on Halloween was 1987 with .25"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement SUNDAY: Breezy and Wet! This should be our best day for precip, especially in the AM. Showers should begin tapering off through the day but still could be responsible for ponding or minor flooding. 
 RAIN TOTALS: Expecting between .25" - .50" for the valley. Up to 1" possible in the higher terrain and mountains. SNOW LEVELS will drop from 9,000 to 8,500', so expect a few inches or less
 WINDS: Breezy Sunday and Monday with gusts up to 35 mph
